reviews.text: I really enjoy this conditioner. I have fine, wavy hair and it did a good job of conditioning but it’s not the most moisturizing conditioner. If you have dry hair this might be too light of a conditioner.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款護髮素。我嘅頭髮係幼身又有微捲，佢嘅護理效果幾好，不過佢唔係最滋潤嗰款護髮素。如果你頭髮好乾，呢款可能會太輕身。

reviews.text: Bought entire line. Was hoping this would add some good extra moisture but it doesn't. I have fine Caucasian hair and I believe that may be the issue. This is more for low porosity hair and I am more in the middle.
reviews.zh: 我買咗成個系列。本來希望可以加多少少保濕，但係冇效果。我嘅頭髮係幼身嘅白人髮質，我諗可能係呢個原因。呢款更適合低孔隙度嘅頭髮，而我嘅頭髮屬於中等。

reviews.text: this is fantastic! It smells so fresh and invigorating, and it leaves my scalp feeling really clean and refreshed. The lightweight formula nourishes without feeling heavy, and my hair feels softer and healthier after each use. I love how convenient it is as a 3-in-1 treatment—it’s perfect for keeping both my hair and scalp in great condition.
reviews.zh: 好正！味道好清新、提神，用完令頭皮感覺好乾淨、清爽。質地清爽，滋養唔會覺得厚重，每次用完頭髮都變得更軟、更健康。我好鍾意佢可以做三合一護理，好啱用嚟令頭髮同頭皮都保持好狀態。

reviews.text: While I've been using this product consistently once a week, I haven't observed a significant difference in my hair yet. It's important to note that some hair care products require consistent use over a longer period to achieve optimal results. On a positive note, the rosemary scent is quite pleasant.
reviews.zh: 我每個禮拜都有穩定咁用呢款產品一次，但係暫時未見到頭髮有明顯改善。要留意，有啲護髮產品需要較長時間持續使用，先可以達到最佳效果。正面講，迷迭香味都幾好聞。

reviews.text: This is my second time repurchasing this item! It’s been a game changer for my hair! It’s made my hair so soft and stronger! I also work in a kindergarten class and lice hate rosemary so that’s an added bonus!
reviews.zh: 呢個係我第二次回購！真係改寫咗我護髮嘅遊戲規則！令我頭髮好軟、又更加強韌！我仲喺幼稚園班房做嘢，蝨子最憎迷迭香，所以又係多一個好處！

reviews.text:
Hit or miss
I think this product does help with hairless but I noticed it did make my hair dry, frizzy not really smooth like I would have wanted but in terms of helping with hair loss I did see a difference but not a life changing difference I'll use up thr whole bottle but I don't think I'd repurchase
reviews.zh:
好壞參半
我覺得呢款產品對脫髮有幫助，但係我發現佢令頭髮變得乾、毛躁，唔係我想要嗰種順滑。至於幫助脫髮方面，我真係見到啲分別，但唔係改變人生嗰種大分別。我會用完成支，但我諗我唔會再買。

reviews.text: I bought the whole set as I’ve been having trouble with hair growth and I was recommended to find something with rosemary in it. I enjoy the shampoo and conditioner, smells great, but I haven’t really seen any improvement and my hair seems dryer then before.
reviews.zh: 我買咗成套產品，因為我一直都有頭髮生長嘅問題，有人建議我搵含迷迭香嘅產品。我鍾意洗頭水同護髮素，味道好好聞，不過我真係未見到有咩改善，頭髮似乎比以前更乾。

reviews.text: Only used a few times so far, I put it on my scalp as well due to the rosemary extract that I hope will help hair growth. My scalp doesn't get overly oily even though I use this, but keep in mind I have dry skin and hair!
reviews.zh: 我到目前只用咗幾次，因為當中有迷迭香萃取，我亦都有塗喺頭皮上，希望可以幫助頭髮生長。我嘅頭皮用咗之後都唔會好油，不過要留意，我嘅皮膚同頭髮都係乾性嘅！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
